## Mathematical premises, not extra numerical decisions

With only F_k=A_k fixed linear, retain
A_k y_k^in - A_k[Pi_k(m_k^applied)] + B_k(m_k^applied).
Define D_k=B_k-A_k o Pi_k, use its linear model response, and use the joint
covariance formula only when A_k, Pi_k and B_k are all exact fixed linear maps
on the stated spaces, units, support, state and conditioning. Candidate or
accepted covariance does not replace applied-model covariance by implication.
Mapping signatures alone do not prove linearity.
Zero-feedback and identity limiting cases state their zero-preserving/domain/
support premises. These type and logic conditions make the owner's formulas
precise; they select no numerical operator or special-case default.
The final amendment additionally binds the exact additive reference/gauge and
null-space state for all displayed arithmetic and covariance. Rejoined content
in an upstream unavailable mode remains model_or_prior_supported, never an
implicit recovered observation, exposure or unit-response truth.

If an inherited authority and a scoped FRUIT direction appear to conflict,
identify the exact claim and owner boundary; do not silently modify upstream
science. The frozen PTC fragment is retained byte-for-byte with a notation
cover. Remaining absent method fields stay unavailable while conditional
scientific authorship remains permitted after exact packet approval.
